Beamhop 是原生 macOS 菜单栏工具：捕获材料，保留来源与交代，交给外: Beamhop is a native macOS menu-bar utility for capturing material with its source and instructions, then handing it to an external AI tool. Explore the native interface and interactive design essays.
选中一段内容，带上来源和一句交代，: Select a passage, keep its source and add an instruction.
交给外部工具，或先留在手边。: Hand it to an external tool, or hold it for later.
现有应用与设计探索分别展示。新随笔中的本地推荐尚未实现。: The current app and design explorations are shown separately. Local recommendations in the new essay are not implemented yet.
按 ⌘⇧Space 捕获选区，在浮层中选择去处、补充提示词。可以复制、填入草稿等: Press ⌘⇧Space to capture a selection, choose a destination and add a prompt. Copy it, prepare a draft for review, or press ⌘5 to hold it for later.
工作名称目前记住的是应用，不是精确会话地址。填入不等于已发送或已执行。当前是开发: A work name currently remembers an application, not an exact session address. Preparing a draft does not mean it has been sent or executed. This is a development preview with no tagged release yet.

可以动手试的设计探索。会话、建议和回执均为模拟，不连接你的应用。: Hands-on design explorations. Sessions, suggestions and receipts are simulated; these pages do not connect to your apps.
更轻的浮层、首屏提示词，以及不依赖模型的本地推荐。: A lighter panel, an immediately visible prompt field and local recommendations without model dependencies.
事情可以分岔，思路不必散掉。: Work can branch. Keep your train of thought.
在文章里选材料。需要时才打开右下角的暂存架。: Select passages in the article. Open the corner shelf only when needed.
让信息过去，人留在这里。: Send the information. Stay where you are.
第一次认出去处，让下一份材料少找一次路。: Recognize a destination once, then find it more easily for the next passage.
